title: Bachmann M-Module file wiretap and dissector support added.
description:
Adding support for Bachmann's M-Module file format. Here, as standalone file for .m files via wiretap.
Also added some heuristic support for currently un-fragmented tcp data, and a few mime types.

Doesn't this work out to mathematically be zero if all bytes are added up (regardless of the location of the checksum)?

Yes if all bytes are added, and what I'll call the compliment exists. In this case, skip at offset 0x2c (44, where i==11), which holds the current checksum of the other bytes. If the current checksum is included in the calculation, then yes, it should all add to zero. I'll separate these out in order to be sure calculation and verification are separated. This way if we, in the future, want to provide correct checksum when incorrect, that can be more easily called.
I see. Combined with the above, a more efficient way may be read a few bytes at a time, and simply check for 0 as result. Will explore this further.
Fixed to read 4 bytes at a time, and calculate for zero, which would mean checksum is correct.
This is a REALLY EXPENSIVE heuristic to have to walk the entire file (especially if its large) to see if it's of this type.

You will need to add lines for MSVC somewhere (perhaps at the top of the file for clarity) like:

```c
#ifdef _MSC_VER
/* disable: "warning C4146: unary minus operator applied to unsigned type, result still unsigned" */
```

I guess other protocols need other special handling.
I remove this in !22084 so let's handle a generic `application/octet-stream` separately.

commits_data.title: Bachmann M-Module file wiretap and dissector support added.
commits_data.message:
Bachmann M-Module file wiretap and dissector support added.

Adding support for Bachmann's M-Module file format. Here, as standalone file for .m files via wiretap.
Also added some heuristic support for currently un-fragmented tcp data, and a few mime types.

Updated encoding and removed http and tcp heuristic layers for now, and
added an m-file test application. Added entry for test capture file for m_module wiretap and dissector

Additionally, updated based on MR suggestions and fixed up unary error for Windows compilation.
